description: Vercel edge deployment engineering: Edge Runtime optimization, Serverless Functions, Preview Deployments, Edge Config, Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR), and Web Vitals analytics.
instructionsMarkdown:
# Vercel Edge Runtime & Serverless Deployment

Deploy and operate hyper-fast modern web applications on Vercel's global edge network.

## Key Principles & Invariants
- Optimize Edge Functions to execute well within the 50ms CPU runtime budget.
- Scope environment variables strictly across Development, Preview, and Production targets.
- Implement On-Demand Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR) using `revalidateTag` and `revalidatePath`.
- Monitor Real User Metrics (RUM) and maintain high Core Web Vitals scores.
